author_actor.note: The authoring session: it staged the draft, wrote the review and the evidence pack, and drove eleven AD-04 quorum rounds over its own output. Every commit carries the operator's git identity, so git metadata cannot distinguish it; the id names the session.

reviewer_actor.note: Section 3.E consultation: a separate invocation in a disposable git-archive tree with no .git, no remote and no path back to the worktree, with the diff and prompt passed as files and no access to the authoring session's reasoning trace. Cross-vendor at the level of harness and requested model. It is NOT verifiable from this receipt that a Gemini model answered: model_id records what was requested on argv, and nothing in agy's output carries the answering model. Recorded rather than omitted, because a receipt presenting this as proven independence would be the self-flattery section 5 exists to prevent.

findings.text: PMAT-1092's acceptance criterion read '12 scripts/workflows/contracts ... 11 of 12 are ABSENT' where the review's headline and GT-1 read 21 paths with 19 absent.
findings.failure_scenario: The roadmap entry is the source of truth for what done means, so a criterion reading 11 of 12 is satisfied by fixing eleven paths and silently drops the other eight.
